notes: The two articles are decided on rule 20's availability test: τήν has no genitive pronoun beside it and takes the supplied *his*, while τό is displaced by αὐτοῦ.
δέ is unrepresented, the ASV writing no connective; the supplied *What* completes the elliptical protasis and rides with εἰ under rule 7.
*make known* heads on *known* under rules 17 and 91.
